summary: Hot-load the FULL stack (PCM + CGM 0.5.12 + OIO) + this runtime. Versions come from the release train via stack-mesh.json; the adopter's stack-manifest.json carries empty pins and follows the train. The installer is a gated conductor: it classifies every existing path, refuses to clobber foreign/edited content, and reports a PARTIAL install (never a fake OK) when a component such as OIO cannot be installed. Join order fills roles. Boss lease default 30m (15–120). GitHub-canonical claim_queue after vacancy; returning boss joins end. Agent-less watchdog ~10m. Slim subsets are incomplete installs.
